The Simple Guide

DataFusion Platform

Turn messy Excel files into one clean report. Follow the pictures below, step by step — that's it.

🔒 Everything stays on your computer. Nothing is ever uploaded anywhere.
Jump to a step
Install 1. Import 2. Organize 3. Validate 4. Consolidate 5. Results 6. Filters 7. Analytics 8. Export The Report Help
✓

Install the app

You get one file: DataFusionPlatform_Setup.exe. Double-click it, and it does the rest.

  1. Double-click DataFusionPlatform_Setup.exe.
  2. If Windows shows a blue warning screen, click “More info”, then “Run anyway.” This is normal and safe.
  3. Click Next → Next → Install → Finish.
That's it. A shortcut now appears on your Desktop. Double-click it any time to open the app.
1

Open the app and bring in your files

This is the app the moment it opens. Click “Import Files” on the left to choose your Excel files.

  1. Click 📥 Import Files in the menu on the left.
  2. Pick one or more Excel files (hold Ctrl to pick several at once).
  3. Only .xlsx files work. Your original files are never changed — the app only reads them.
2

If a file looks messy, choose how to clean it

Some Excel exports have extra title rows above the real data. If the app spots this, it stops and asks you what to do — for that whole batch of files.

📄 Keep As-Is

Keeps every row exactly as it is, including the title rows at the top. Choose this if you're not sure.

✨ Auto-Organize

Removes the title rows automatically and keeps only the real data table. Best for a quick, clean result.

🙂 Simple rule: not sure which to pick? Choose Auto-Organize. It's the safer, easier choice for most files.
3

Check your data for problems

Click “Validate Data” in the menu. The app checks every file for you and shows a plain-English list of anything wrong. Nothing is changed — it only reports.

👉 See the “What each colour means” section near the end for how to fix each type of problem.
4

Combine your files into one

Click “Consolidate”. Tick which files (and sheets) you want combined, then click the green button.

Debit ≠ Credit? If your numbers don't balance, the app stops and shows you exactly which file and row to fix — it never lets a mismatch through silently. Fix it in Excel, save, click Refresh, and you're through.
5

See your results

This screen shows your combined totals at a glance — how many rows, and whether everything balances.

6

Search and filter your data

Go to “Filters & Search” in the menu. Type a word to search everything, or set up precise conditions (e.g. “Amount is greater than 10,000”).

💡 Filtered results feed straight into Analytics and can be exported on their own.
7

See charts and summaries

Click “Analytics” to see your data turned into simple charts and totals — no spreadsheet skills needed.

8

Save your final report

Click “Export”, choose where to save, and you're done. You'll get one Excel file with everything neatly organized.

📊

What's inside your final report

The exported workbook has several tabs. Here's what a few of them really look like:

What each colour means on the Issues tab

  • Amber — Missing info. A cell that should have a value (like Amount) is empty. Open the file, fill it in, save, and re-import.
  • Blue — Exact duplicate rows. Two rows are 100% identical. Delete one, save, and re-import.
  • Indigo — Duplicate invoice numbers. The same invoice number appears twice. Check if it's a real duplicate or fix the number.
  • Red — Missing invoice number. A number in your sequence (e.g. INV-1002) never appears. Check if it was cancelled, or add it.
🔒

DataFusion Platform works completely offline. It never connects to the internet and never uploads your files anywhere. Everything stays on your computer — that's by design, to protect your data.

Quick help

App won't open? Make sure you ran the real Setup.exe — not a file from inside a zip folder.
A file won't import? Check it's a real .xlsx file — not .xls, and not password-protected.
Acting strange after an update? Close it fully from Task Manager, then reopen it.
